sentences.en: Sir, you are not allowed to park your car here.
sentences.zh: 先生，您不允许在这里停车。

sentences.en: How much is the car you are planning to buy?
sentences.zh: 你打算买的那辆车多少钱？

sentences.en: The locomotive was pulling a long line of freight cars.
sentences.zh: 这台机车牵引着一列长长的货运车厢。

senses.zh: 汽车, 轿车 - (火车)车厢 CAR中非共和国
